newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Feb 12.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on February 12. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The immigration authorities in south Kalimantan are questioning two French pilots for landing their planes without proper documents at the Syamsuddin Noor airport in capital Banjarmasin.

The Communion of Churches in Indonesia has called for a transparent and comprehensive investigation into recent religious and ethnic riots in the country. At least 10 people were killed and properties belonging to ethnic Chinese and Christians destroyed in three riots on Java Island.

Cellular telephone operator PT Komselindo plans to offer 25 percent of its shares to foreign investors this year. Five of the seven cellular telephone operators in Indonesia have so far taken foreign partners.
The Indonesian interior ministry plans to issue an instruction to regulate the distribution of alcoholic drinks in the country.
